symptom:
A deposit ledger (server/main.go) appends each ADD n to data/ledger.log and answers OK; TOTAL returns the sum of the entries, rebuilt from the log on start. The client makes 150 deposits, remembers which were acknowledged and which were not, and at the end checks that the ledger total is at least the sum of the acknowledged deposits and at most the sum of everything it ever sent. Crashes can land in the middle of a disk write, leaving an incomplete last line in the log.

Observed on seed 1: the server was crashed 36 times, 35 of them during a disk operation. The final check failed: ledger total holds no deposit that was never sent: {"left":9272,"right":7337}. The total was larger than everything the client had sent.

Expected: the total must be at least the sum of acknowledged deposits and at most the sum of all deposits sent, whatever crashes happen.
